# NestJS Patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor: a patterns skill for building and reviewing NestJS backends the way production teams do. It covers the full framework surface: modular architecture (feature modules with clear boundaries), controllers kept thin with validation pipes, providers and dependency injection done right, DTOs with class-validator for input contracts, guards for authorization, interceptors for logging and response shaping, and configuration management across environments. Every pattern ships with concrete TypeScript examples, so you see the idiomatic decorator-driven version instead of a generic Express transliteration. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: pure guidance, nothing to install; assumes a working NestJS project and TypeScript basics; examples follow current NestJS conventions, very old versions may differ. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
